description: React component for a custom time picker modal used to set Do Not Disturb (DND) status in Mattermost, including date/time handling, localization, and keyboard interactions.

classes.name: DndCustomTimePicker
classes.description: React component class for a modal to select a custom DND end time.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes component state, sets default selected date/time based on current date.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Adds keydown event listener for ESC key to close modal.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keydown events, closes modal on ESC key press.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a date for display using relative format.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns localized header and button text for modal.

methods.name: handleConfirm
methods.description: Sets user DND status with selected end time and closes modal.

methods.name: handleDateTimeChange
methods.description: Updates state with new selected date/time.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the modal with date/time input and buttons.
